title: Choose the learning workspace direction
question: Which direction should carry forward? These are visual proposals with illustrative data, before app implementation.

options.label: Joined progress
options.thesis: Previous effort stays visible while one manageable next action takes focus.
options.viewport: A broad next-action area joins a narrow complete learning path through one eight-part progress strip. Quiet return and support areas sit below.
options.risk: The joined-strip motif needs careful restraint so it does not resemble a game board.

raised.raise: Use consistent attribution and restrained spacing across every supporting section.
Keep completed, current and upcoming states distinct in text as well as color.
Keep supporting explanation close to the action it explains.
Keep the entire eight-step scope scannable without shrinking the text.
Make activity and completion separate, explicitly labeled quantities.

options.label: Open study page
options.thesis: A clear central study action, with progress and support placed in the margins.
options.viewport: The next study action sits in the main reading column; a compact left path and right support margin keep the entire journey in view.
options.risk: The familiar notebook hierarchy is easy to understand, but less distinctive than the joined-progress direction.

options.label: One clear next turn
options.thesis: Make the next decision unmistakable while keeping the full route nearby.
options.viewport: A left-aligned next-step band leads into the working area, with the remaining path adjacent and optional support beneath.
options.case: Strong on next-action clarity; less directly associated with personal learning than the assigned direction.
options.risk: Yellow can overpower the learning content unless confined to the current step and primary action.

options.label: Design annual
options.kept: Attribution discipline retained; editorial framing adds less learner recognition and next-action clarity.
options.viewport: Not proposed for the first learning workspace.
options.risk: Adds visual decoding without improving the next study action.
options.case: Attribution discipline retained; editorial framing adds less learner recognition and next-action clarity.

options.label: Orienteering map
options.thesis: Keep the current point and retained progress legible.
options.kept: State distinctions retained; map conventions add a decoding burden to a daily study action.
options.viewport: Not proposed for the first learning workspace.
options.risk: Adds visual decoding without improving the next study action.
options.case: State distinctions retained; map conventions add a decoding burden to a daily study action.

options.label: Reference setting
options.kept: Proximity retained; multiple annotation rails complicate small-screen study.
options.viewport: Not proposed for the first learning workspace.
options.risk: Adds visual decoding without improving the next study action.
options.case: Proximity retained; multiple annotation rails complicate small-screen study.

options.label: Event catalog
options.thesis: Expose the full scope without hiding entries.
options.kept: Scope visibility retained; tiny index codes weaken readability and learner identification.
options.viewport: Not proposed for the first learning workspace.
options.risk: Adds visual decoding without improving the next study action.
options.case: Scope visibility retained; tiny index codes weaken readability and learner identification.

options.label: Exposure record
options.kept: Quantity labels retained; darkroom conventions are distant from the learner task.
options.viewport: Not proposed for the first learning workspace.
options.risk: Adds visual decoding without improving the next study action.
options.case: Quantity labels retained; darkroom conventions are distant from the learner task.

canonCard.label: Familiar workspace
canonCard.thesis: A conventional learning dashboard with a clear next action and familiar supporting panels.
canonCard.viewport: A standard left navigation and broad main workspace, with progress above the next action and support below.
canonCard.risk: Familiar and easy to scan, but provides less visual distinction.
